s: Seder lel yom hakkippurim ubo y"ch seipim: lel yom hakkippurim nohagin sheqqodem shemmitpalelin — mattirim lekol haabaryanim, vehen haoberim al gezerot vechermot haqqahal mattirin lahen kede shennukal lehitpallel immahem baagudda achat, sheameru chakamim kol taanit tzibbur sheen bo mipposhee yisrael — eno taanit, shehare chelbena rechah ra umenaah hakkatub im sammane haqqetoret. Veketzad mattirin lahem? Haggadol shebbaqqahal metzarep immo shene anashim, kede shehem yihyu meshullachim shel kol haqqahal lehattir lahem. Veim haggadol shebbaqqahal hu sheliach tzibbur (qabua bair) — eno tzarik letzarep immo shum adam lehattir lahem, lepi sheyyadua shehu sheliach hatztzibbur, vahare zeh keillu kol haqqahal hittiru lahem. Veyomar bezeh hallashon "bishiba shel mala ubishiba shel matta, al daat hammaqom veal daat haqqahal, anu mattirin lehitpallel im haabaryanim", kelomar shehayshibot maskimot letzarep daat hammaqom ledaat haqqahal lehattir lahem. Velo yomar battechilla "al daat hammaqom veal daat haqqahal" veachar kak "bishiba shel mala ku'":

Veachar kak omer hashsheliach tzibbur "kol nidre ku'". Veyomar "miyyom hakkippurim zeh ad yom kippurim habba alenu letoba ku'", venohagin ken kede lehatnot al kol nedarim sheyyiddoru bashshana habbaa sheyyihyu betelim, lepi sheen haolam nizharim bindarim veoberim al "lo yachel debaro", lekak mebattelin otan battechilla qodem sheyyachulu, shehattenay moil lebattel hanneder shello yachul kelal kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman ry"a (veayyen sham kol dine bittul hanneder), ulekak tzarik lomar "icharatna behon ku'", kelomar kol hannedarim sheeddor bashshana habbaa ani mitcharet alehen meakshav umatneh alehen sheyyihyu betelin:

Vegam kol haqqahal yomru "kol nidre ku'" belachash im hashsheliach tzibbur (veayyen beyoreh dea sham detzarik lomar beqol ram meat, beinyan sheyyehe nishma lehaomedim etzlo), kede sheyyatneh kol echad veechad bipne atzmo al nedarayv sheyyiddor bashshana habbaa, sheen tenay hashsheliach tzibbur moil laacherim, ulekak nitqan bilshon yachid "deindarna", "o di nedarna", o "dindarna", "o deishtabbana", "o deacharimena ku'", kelomar mah sheeddor veeshshaba veacharim veeesor nekasay, ben al napshi ben al nepashot acherot, "miyyom kippurim zeh ad yom hakkippurim ku'" (velo yomar di nadarna beqama"tz tachat nu"n rishona, lepi shemmashmautah hu shennadarti kebar):

Venohagin lehatchil "kol nidre" mibbeod yom, deen mattirin nedarim beshabbat veyom tob, veap al pi sheen anu mattirin hannedarim shelleabar ella anu mebattelin hannedarim shellehabba, mikkol maqom hu domeh qetzat lehattarat nedarim, veyesh lachosh shemma yitu lomar mattirin nedarim beshabbat veyom tob. Umittaam zeh nohagin lehaamid shene anashim etzel hashsheliach tzibbur beshaa sheomer "kol nidre", kede shello yitu lomar mattirin nedarim beyachid:

Venohagin shehashsheliach tzibbur omer oto g' peamim, vekol paam magbiah haqqol yoter mibbarishona, lepi shebbederek zo nishma beema ubeyira. Umamshik beniggunim ad hallayla, kede lehitpallel arbit bizmannah:

Veachar kak omer hashsheliach tzibbur g' peamim "venislach ku'", vehaqqahal omerim g' peamim "vayyomer Hashem ku'". Veal yeshanneh adam mimminhag hair apillu bepiyyutim o beniggunim shemmenaggenim sham, shello yebalbel daat haqqahal:

Veachar kak omer hashsheliach tzibbur "shehecheyanu" belo kos, lepi sheyyom hakkippurim hu dabar habba mizzeman lizman vetzarik lebarek "shehecheyanu" kemo bekol haregalim, ella shei epshar lebarek al hakkos mibbeod yom, mishshum shekkevan shebberak she"higgianu lizman hazzeh" — hare qibbel alayv yom hakkippurim, veasur lo lishtot min hakkos, vegam i epshar lebarek al hakkos velitten mimmennu letinoq, mittaam shennitbaer besiman tqn"v, ayyen sham:

Umin haddin haya nakon shekkol haqqahal yetzeu yede chobatan bebirkat hashsheliach tzibbur velo yebarek kol echad veechad bipne atzmo lepi she"berab am hadrat melek" kemo shennitbaer besiman rtz"ch, ella sheakshav al harob en hashsheliach tzibbur mekavven kelal lehotzi acherim, laken yebarek kol echad veechad leatzmo belachash, veyizzaher lesayyem qodem sheyyesayyem hashsheliach tzibbur kede sheyyukal laanot amen achar birkat hashsheliach tzibbur. Veken haddin bebirkat hallel. Veken haddin bebirkat hallulab shebbebet hakkeneset:

Lel yom hakkippurim umochorato omerim "baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed" beqol ram, lepi sheameru bammidrash kesheala mosheh lammarom shama lemalake hashsharet shehayu meqallesin lehaqqadosh baruk hu "baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed", vehorido leyisrael, vetzivva lahem leomro bachashay, mashal leadam shegganab chepetz naeh mittok palterin shel melek unetanah leishto veamar lah al titqashsheti bo ella betzina betok betek, laken kol hashshana omerim oto belachash, abal beyom hakkippurim sheanu domin lemalakim kemo shennitbaer besiman tr"y — anu omerim oto beqol ram beparhesya:

Im chal beshabbat — omerim "vaykullu" achar tepillat arbit, vehashsheliach tzibbur omer beraka achat meen sheba vechotem "meqaddesh hashshabbat", veeno mazkir yom hakkippurim bibraka zo, mittaam shennitbaer besiman rs"ch. Veen omerim qabbalat shabbat, abal "mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat" yesh leomro qodem "bareku":
Veen omerim "abinu malkenu" keshechal beshabbat, millebad bitpillat neila kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trk"g, abal shear hasselichot vehattechinnot omerim kemo keshechal bechol:
En omerim "beahaba miqra qodesh" apillu keshechal beshabbat, abal "beahaba" harishon omerim apillu bechol:

Venohagin sheen omerim "eloqenu veloqe abotenu retzeh bimnuchatenu" keshechal beshabbat, dekevan shehu yom innuy en lanu ratzon kol kak bimnuchatenu, veek nitpallel sheyyirtzeh haqqadosh baruk hu bimnuchatenu sheenah menucha gemura, abal omerim "vehanchilenu beahaba uberatzon shabbat qodsheka ku'", shezzehu baqqasha al kol shabbetot hashshana sheenan yom hakkippurim, veachar kak omerim "vetaher libbenu leobdeka beemet ki atta solchan ku'", kelomar sheal yede hasselicha metaher libbenu (udelo kemo shekkatub biqtzat machazorim bitpillat rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim "vetaher libbenu ku'" qodem "vehanchilenu ku'", sheek shayyak lomar achar kak "ki atta solchan ku'", o "ki atta elohim emet"):

Bekol tepillot yom hakkippurim tzarik lehaamid shene anashim etzel hashsheliach tzibbur echad mimino veechad missemolo, kemo bekol taanit tzibbur kemo shennitbaer besiman tqs"v ayyen sham, veakshav en nohagin kelal lehaamid shene anashim etzel hashsheliach tzibbur bekol taanit tzibbur mittaam shennitbaer sham, velaken gam beyom hakkippurim en tzarik lehaamid, velaken nohagin shettekep achar "bareku" holekin meal hashsheliach tzibbur haanashim sheamedu etzlo bishat amirat "kol nidre":

Yesh nohagin laamod al raglehem kol hayyom vekol hallayla, dehaynu kol zeman shehem neorim ballayla en yoshebin. Abal mikkol maqom tzerikin lishon ballayla, kede sheyyukelu lehitpallel bayyom bekavvana velo yitnamnemu bitpillatam:

Veim nechleshu — yekolim lismok leshum dabar. Umi sheamad paam achat kol yom hakkippurim vehaya bedato linhog ken leolam, im rotzeh leshannot minhago — tzarik hattara kemo neder, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman rt"v:

Hannashim en lahem laamod kol yom hakkippurim, lepi sheen toelet baamidatam, sheiqqar taam haamida hu kede lihyot dugmat hammalakim shenniqraim "omedim", vezeh en shayyak bannashim, kemo shennitbaer besiman tr"y:

Ap al pi shebbekol hashshana asur lishon bebet hakkeneset, mikkol maqom belel yom hakkippurim nohagin lishon bebet hakkeneset, lepi sheomerim sham shirot vetishbachot rob hallayla, veyesh yeshenim sham kede lishmor et hannerot, veen kan chashash issur kevan shehu tzorek bet hakkeneset kemo shennitbaer besiman qn"a. Ak yizzaharu lishon bemaarab rachoq min haaron, o bebet hakkeneset shel nashim im en sham nashim. Abal otam sheenam rotzim lomar sham shirot vetishbachot — lo yishenu kelal bebet hakkeneset. Vehachazzanim hammitpalelim bayyom — lo yeoru kol hallayla, lepi shemmapsidim et qolam kesheenam yeshenim ballayla. Vaapillu kol adam — tob lo shello yeor kol hallayla, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Vetob lomar qodem hashshena d' mizmorim harishonim shel tehillim, shehem shemira leqeri. Vegam tob lizzaher shello yaatop et atzmo bekarim ukesatot, shello yabo lide chimmum, veal kol panim yizzaher shello lekassot raglayv, zeker laddabar "vattegal margelotayv" shel boaz, shello yabo lide chimmum:
